metaTitle: Custom Spandex Lanyards & Badges | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom spandex lanyards & badges for your team. Soft, stretchy, and comfortable for all-day wear at events or offices.
introHtml: Spandex lanyards offer a soft, stretchy feel that standard polyester can't match. They're ideal for trade shows, schools, and corporate offices where staff wear badges all day. The fabric conforms to the neck without pulling or chafing, and it holds up to repeated use. Add your logo with screen printing or full-color dye sublimation for a vibrant, wrinkle-resistant finish that stays comfortable even in warm climates.
heroAltText: Custom spandex lanyards and badges with printed logos, soft stretchy material for comfortable daily wear.
